## Corporate Overview


Seagate Technology (NASDAQ: STX) is a leading innovator in mass-capacity data storage, enabling organizations to harness one of their most valuable assets: Data.


With more than 45 years of technology leadership and approximately 30,000 employees worldwide, Seagate delivered over 789 exabytes of data storage capacity in FY26 to customers across consumer, cloud, enterprise, and edge markets throughout the world.


Seagate’s global footprint spans manufacturing, research and development, combining global reach with local expertise to deliver trusted data storage solutions, with storage platforms designed to meet the growing demands of data-intensive workloads driven by AI, cloud computing, and digital transformation.


Seagate's advanced storage platforms help organizations manage, retain, and extract value from growing volumes of information. The company’s breakthrough Mozaic™ technology platform, powered by heat-assisted magnetic recording (HAMR), has established a new foundation for scalable, cost-effective hard drive storage. Currently supporting capacities of up to 44TB hard drives, with projected future capacity transitions enabling up to 100TB, Mozaic empowers world-class data centers to expand storage capacity while maximizing efficiency within data center footprints.


Together with customers and ecosystem partners, Seagate is shaping the future of AI infrastructure by helping organizations harness the value of their data, fuel their transformation, growth and economic opportunity.
